main.description: Complete signup with the link token, choosing a username and password. Deliberi provisions the PDS account internally using a pre-minted invite code.

token.description: Verification token from the emailed link.

username.description: Desired username; the handle is <username>.<pds domain>.

requestUri.description: request_uri of the browser's pushed OAuth authorization request at the PDS. When the PDS supports it, the new account authorizes that request without the PDS sign-in and consent screens.

did.description: DID of the newly provisioned account.

authorization.description: Present when the PDS authorized requestUri for the new account. Without it the browser signs in through the PDS.

errors.name: SignupDisabled
errors.description: Signup is not currently enabled on this service.

errors.name: InvalidCode
errors.description: The verification link is invalid or expired.

errors.name: InvalidUsername
errors.description: The username is invalid or not allowed.

errors.name: EmailAlreadyRegistered
errors.description: An account already exists for this email.

authorization.description: The OAuth authorization response for requestUri, as the PDS would have put it in the redirect.
